decisions.statement: A request from another origin is answered without a cross-origin header.
The native shell's origin is the https origin of the site the shell serves.
The custom scheme an installed build still sends is admitted beside the https origin.
The origin an answer names is the origin the request carried.
A preflight is answered 204 carrying the cross-origin headers alone.
An answer to the native shell keeps its own status and its own body.
A header one answer states wins over a cross-origin header, and that over a carried one.
A header picked up part way through a request is carried by every answer after it.
A route doing its work in its action still answers a preflight through its loader.
A method a route does not serve is refused 405 with the cross-origin headers.

definition: the cross-origin headers a request from the native shell is answered with
